title: Correct wave speed expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide a correct expression for the wave speed, such as (40 + 160n) m/s or (120 + 160n) m/s, accounting for direction and integer n.

title: Correct minimum time
description: Essential Criteria: The response must give the correct numerical answer for the minimum time, which is 1/420 s.

title: Wave propagation direction analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must consider both possible directions of wave propagation (positive and negative x-axis) to determine possible speeds.

title: Particle motion equation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly derive the simple harmonic motion equation for particle P at x=8 m, including its amplitude and angular frequency.

title: Wavelength and travel distance
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must correctly relate the observed waveform shift to the distance traveled, using the wavelength (8 m) and integer multiples.

title: Trigonometric solution for time
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly solve the trigonometric equation (e.g., sin(ωt) = 1/2) to find the minimum positive time for the specified displacement.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All quantities (displacement, speed, time) should be expressed with correct and consistent units (e.g., cm vs. m).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the solution assumes only one propagation direction without justification, or misinterprets the waveform shift direction.

title: Incorrect wave period or frequency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the angular frequency or period is calculated incorrectly from the speed and wavelength, leading to an error in the particle motion equation.
